summary.prose: Building this correction is one small, self-contained edit: a new cache-seeding method on the VS Code review client, and a one-branch change to the panel function that was still resolving content off the narrower pending-only cache. No daemon, no new RPC, no new UI.

tasks.title: Add noteKnownPath and wire openArtifactFrom's not-found branch to it
tasks.summary: Add noteKnownPath(artifactId, mdPath) to DocsReviewClient (vscode-plugin/src/chat/docs-review-client.ts), writing directly into the existing mdPathById/noDocIds maps. Change openArtifactFrom's 'not found in pending()' branch (docs-review-panel.ts) to call deps.client.noteKnownPath(target.artifactId, target.mdPath) then openDoc(ctx, target.artifactId, { readOnly: true, reveal: true }) with no path option, replacing the previous { path: target.mdPath, readOnly: true, reveal: true }.
acceptanceChecks: noteKnownPath seeds noDocIds for an empty mdPath, so content(id) takes the evidence-read branch without a prior pending() call
noteKnownPath seeds mdPathById for a real mdPath, so content(id) takes the markdown-read branch with that exact path without a prior pending() call

openArtifactFrom's 'not found in pending()' branch calls noteKnownPath then opens with no path option, and the resulting pane body loads for a document-less target (reproducing the reviewer's CR-less-BUILD-with-no-BUILD.md and approved-AMD cases)
openArtifactFrom's 'not found in pending()' branch opens correctly for a document-backed, not-pending target (reproducing the reviewer's CR-less-BUILD-with-valid-BUILD.md case)

openArtifactFrom's 'found in pending()' branch is unchanged: it still opens via { kind: summary.kind, reveal: true } with no call to noteKnownPath (reproducing the reviewer's pending-AMD control case)
